page_title: LYO 1-4 MNT | Lyon v Montpellier 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Mathieu Vernice has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Jordan Ferri is replaced by Becir Omeragic (Montpellier).
90+4' It is time for a substitution. Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) is on for Mousa Al-Tamari.
90+4' Johann Lepenant (Lyon) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
90+3' Akor Adams (Montpellier) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 4 Goal! Leo Leroy puts the ball across the area and Akor Adams (Montpellier) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 1:4.
89' Michel Der Zakarian decides to make a substitution. Teji Savanier will be replaced by Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
88' Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
86' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
85' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
83' This is a yellow card! Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
80' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) must think that he is playing a different sport because his behaviour has nothing to do with football and the referee has no choice but to show him a straight red card!
79' Amin Sarr (Lyon) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
78' A sweet pass inside the box gives Akor Adams (Montpellier) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!

77' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Remy Riou!
74' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
69' 1 - 3 Goal Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon)! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) was put through by Sael Kumbedi and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 1:3.
69' Laurent Blanc has decided to substitute Maxence Caqueret and he is replaced by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeffinho trots off the pitch and is replaced by Amin Sarr (Lyon).
68' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
66' 0 - 3 Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Remy Riou with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:3.
66' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Benjamin Lecomte to dive and make a save.
63' The substitution has been made. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has replaced Arnaud Nordin.
61' That was close by Rayan Cherki (Lyon)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
56' A great solo run by Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Remy Riou.
55' A crossfield pass from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) fails to find any of his teammates.
51' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header well wide of the left post from close range.
51' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
48' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sinaly Diomande (Lyon).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
45+3' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) picks up an injury.
45+2' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45+2' Jeffinho (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
44' Lyon will take a corner kick.
43' Foul! Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
40' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' 0 - 2 Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Remy Riou with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
38' The ball is cleared after Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Akor Adams (Montpellier).
34' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' The goal by Montpellier won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
30' The Montpellier players joy may have been justified, because referee Mathieu Vernice is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
29' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Akor Adams (Montpellier) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
29' Johann Lepenant (Lyon) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
28' The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
27' The linesman makes the right call and Lyon will have a corner.
27' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) evades his marker in the box and connects beautifully with the corner from Teji Savanier. Unfortunately for him, the ball just zips a few inches past the right post.
26' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

25' Two players stand over the free kick. Teji Savanier (Montpellier) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from distance is blocked by the defensive wall. The ball goes out for a corner. Montpellier can continue in their attacking effort.

24' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
21' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Remy Riou makes a huge mistake and Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lyon was in an offside position.
17' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
16' Sinaly Diomande (Lyon) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
15' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
13' Sinaly Diomande (Lyon) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
13' Lyon are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

10' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Montpellier force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
5' Jeffinho (Lyon) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game. One of the players from Lyon won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
1' The first half has started.
Lyon will kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
